title: The owner's fourteen notes on 244f3c9b, ten shipped: the guns, the lance and the ram meet the Pearl body where it is drawn (not its record) and a hit lights it; the first hard core's card says harder, not 'do not ram'; a body crawls out of the lip facing the lane instead of gliding back over the hole; a seat never hands back the first person; every soft tier is rammed on contact; the walk a little faster and leaning harder on the heart; the first canyon the beam's width; squads closer; the radar along the ground, so the far side is far; routine satellite launches. The ending answered: the campaign ends at the sector after the back door, then the generator runs on
context: Owner, 2026-10-15, on 244f3c9b: '1) the first white wave should keep aiming towards the gate, and not stay beyond the reach of the rotor. The rotor hit logic needs re-work since we changed the enemies I think. Something it feels as if I'm aiming straight and it does nothing. Maybe we need a slight hit-animation to register the hit, the body lightly flashing white. 2) the line for the quiver. Erase the line with can't RAM them (we have not introduced the tank or the concept of ramming yet). Replace it with these seem to have a harder-core, more dangerous. 3) the sinkhole reads as an inverted cone, although I believe we treat it as a flat surface. It still looks uncanny how the enemies emerge straight up at the center, hovering, instead of having the feeling that they're crawling out. 4) there was a brief bug, which I could not replicate, whereby changing view to the tank led to PoV instead of 3rd person, which breaks the game a bit, especially when carrying a cargo box. 5) I encountered a soft-body enemy which I could not ram with the tank, it kept being just pushed away. 6) in general all enemies must be a bit faster. And with a much stronger bias to head towards the base. 7) the first SOL manual control, the corridor should be smaller, so the enemies cannot escape to the sides. 8) the way we manage multiple enemies as a pack of 5 for fps, have those closer to each other, currently it can feel strange when ramming them to have some too far apart register as hit. 9) the radar shows the immense column of enemies from SOL at the other antipode, as if they were close, but it's on the other side of the planet. 10) once the launcher is ready, let's have it launch a few normal satellites once in a while, gives life to the base. 11) ... Reeds and small ni-dhaira ... 12) ... keep releasing until upper bound UNLESS fps dips below 30 ... file as to investigate. 13) ... sinkholes ... a real slope? 14) 244f3c9b, currently at sector 28, I thought we were finishing earlier than that? What is the new end-game?' (11-13: 2026-10-15-notes-to-investigate-hunters-fps-gate-slopes). FOUND BEHIND THEM. (1) A Pearl body hunts PEARL_FOLLOW.leadHops (0.6) of its hop ahead of its record (a white's hop is 3.6 radii: the body walks up to 2.2 radii, ~6 m, ahead of the point the game tested), and the pilot's gun box (src/sentry-pilot.js inBox), the lance's aim and the slug's landing (src/fx/tower-combat.js), the beam's candidates (src/fx/laser-arsenal.js) and the tank's touch (src/fx/enemy-step.js) all tested e.pos, the record. The reticle on the body was the reticle beside the record. No hit feedback on a body: the kit's tint channel (iLife.w) carried only the slow's ice. Also: 244f3c9b's message said the whites' walk cap went to 0.85, but its diff touched only the comment (git show 244f3c9b -- src/content/pearl-enemies.js): main had white at 1 all along. (2) The line is the first-contact card's facts (src/fx/contact-card.js: 'SOLID CORE · DO NOT RAM · N HP'), shown for the Quiver's first hard core while the hull is still held by the Stalheart. (3) Last round's rim rise (EMERGENCE.rim) put the body at the lip, but the record's cell path starts at the hole's CENTRE and the offset decayed over 4 s from the moment the rise ended, so the body glided back over the hole as its record walked out: the hover. (4) Not reproduced. Two paths could keep a first-person view: SEAT_RETURN_VIEWS (src/domain/seat-view.js) listed 'pov' as a view a seat hands back, and the strip's TANK button left any third-or-pov view as it was. (5) Only the light tiers' brush was the game's ram (PEARL_IMPACT.tiers white/yellow ram: true); a blue, orange or green soft body met the hull's box, was shoved clear (round four's contact), and the game's ram waited for its record, behind the body, to come within touchR. (6) PEARL_PACE radii white 1 (see 1), yellow 0.7, the rest 0.8; at a cell a record strayed onto any exit 5% of the time and otherwise took any exit nearer the heart at random. (7) CANYON halfWidth 2.5 (a 5-cell trench, widened last round) under a pass footprint of 12 m: the bodies along either wall stood outside the beam. (8) PEARL_FOLLOW.squad gap 2.2 and stagger 2 radii: five 2 m bodies stood 17 m across while the ram tested the record's contact radius. (9) src/radar.js radarProject projected the chord pos - centre onto the tangent plane: a far-side contact's chord is mostly along the normal, so it shrank toward the centre (the antipode's to exactly the centre), and proximitySectors graded the far side the same way. (10) src/fx/colony-tick.js launched a collector at the start of every secured sector once SOL-88 was up, nothing else. (14) src/fx/sector-run.js finalSector = doorAt + 1 (BOTH WALLS, at sector 8 or 9: SECTOR_DOOR earliest 7, latest 8); securing it plays THE ENDING and, after the debrief, the campaign board; cont() then begins def.n + 1 and SECTOR_GENERATOR serves sectors with no end (alive +75 a sector to 1,200, threat +0.15 a sector). Sector 28 is the endless run after the ending; there is no second ending.
outcome: (1) src/fx/creature-pearl.js point(handle): the body's drawn centre in its hub's plane; src/fx/creature-bodies.js point(record) maps it onto the unit sphere and the creature stand-in carries userData.point() from its spawn; src/fx/lance-follow.js groundAt(e) (that point or e.pos) and bodyAt(e) (lifted for a dot cloud) are what the pilot's box, the lance's aim, the two slug landings, the beam's body candidates and nearestBodyM, and the tank's touch on a SOFT body read. A hard body's touch stays on its record: on its body it fired at every hull contact and its recoil kept the body ahead of a hull that should have stopped on it (--pearl-story's hull probe: the drifter 26.3 -> 24.6 m/s; on the record 28.2 -> 0.9). THE HIT FLASH: creature-enemies' hit (damageEnemy's every hit) sets e.hitFlash 1; creature-bodies lookInto rides it on the tint channel at 2 + the share left, fading over CREATURE_FOLLOW.flash (0.18 s); the kit's fragment shader (src/fx/cutis-maku/shaders.js) reads 2 and over as a white flash (0.6) and under 2 as the ice. (2) showContact(root, type, pearl, { hull }): before the hull is issued (story.hull.held()) a hard core's card says 'HARDER CORE · MORE DANGEROUS'. (3) EMERGENCE.facing (pi/2): at its breach's own cell a body rises on the half of the rim facing its first exit; the offset is held whole while the record's path point is inside the rim (e.riseAt) and only then glides over settle, now 8 s (at 4 the decay rode on the full walk and hurried the black tier's transfer to 0.26-0.37 radii a frame: 5 pops). A body risen up the lane (cell: the head start, the canyon's column) scatters on its spread as before. (4) SEAT_RETURN_VIEWS ['third', 'orbit']; the strip's TANK lands on 'third' unless already there. (5) PEARL_IMPACT.contact.ramSoft: every soft tier the driving hull touches is e.bodyRam (the brush), the game's ram with its bounty, combo and bump (the light tiers still without the bump). (6) PEARL_PACE radii white 1, yellow 0.85, black 0.8, the rest 0.9: the motion audit is the ceiling (test/pearl-motion.mjs popped purple at 1 for all and blue at 1.1; --pearl-story popped black once at 0.9). WALK_BIAS { stray 0.02, straight 0.6 } through src/domain/impact-scare.js seekExits: under stray any exit, under straight only the exits nearest the heart, else any nearer one. (7) CANYON halfWidth 1.5 (3 cells) under a pass radius of 15 m. (8) PEARL_FOLLOW.squad gap 1.1, stagger 1.2. (9) src/radar.js scopeOffset: the great-circle distance along the contact's tangent bearing; radarProject uses it (the antipode pins to the rim); proximitySectors skips contacts over the horizon; the heart map's range is pi x 1.01 (src/fx/radar-scope.js). (10) ORBITAL_WORKS.routine { first 75, every [150, 300] }: src/domain/orbital-works.js routineDue/beginRoutine/routineUp, src/fx/colony-tick.js puts a plain satellite up the rail when nothing else is on the sled (a collector's launch first), no brief, no bonus; the harness sees works.routines and the sector note { type: 'launch', id: 'routine' }. (14) Answered to the owner; no change: the end-game past BOTH WALLS is the generator's endless run, his call what it should be.
alternatives: Shrink PEARL_FOLLOW.leadHops so the record is where the body is: rejected; the lead is the gait (the body leads, the record waits for it), and the hit tests were simply reading the wrong point.
Walk caps at 1 or 1.1 for every tier ('a bit faster'): rejected by the motion audit (purple at 1, blue at 1.1, black at 0.9 in the browser).
Keep the first-person as a seat return view: rejected; the story never asks for it and the owner saw it break the cargo carry.

Burn what rises at a breach's lip from a beam held on its centre (a body burn radius spanning the crater): not done; the lip is 9.5 m from the centre and the pass footprint 8 m, so a beam held on the hole seals it but burns the risers only when dragged to the lip or the lane (--laser-game's expectation moved from the footprint to the lip). The owner judges whether the lesson still reads.

A hold-the-offset-until-out rule by time instead of the rim distance: rejected; the hover came from the record starting at the hole's centre, and only the rim distance says when the record is clear of it.
Erase 'DO NOT RAM' from every card: rejected; after the hull is issued the warning is the read the board is built on; only the card before the hull says harder.
evidence: git show 244f3c9b -- src/content/pearl-enemies.js (the comment-only diff: the whites' cap at 1 on main)

node test/radar.mjs (the antipode pins to the rim, the far side does not register), test/impact-scare.mjs (seekExits), test/orbital-works.mjs (routineDue), test/seat-view.mjs, test/pearl-motion.mjs (the caps), test/body-quads.mjs (the squad's folding pinned at its own spacing), test/enemy-step.mjs; npm test (257), npm run check (td-tab 6,124 under 6,400), npm run build

browser suites, 2026-10-15: --pearl-story (the motion audit 0/0 pops on every tier, the hull probes: the white run over 26.6 -> 25.2 m/s, the drifter stopping the hull 28.2 -> 0.9), --laser-game (the risers at the lip, 13.2 m from the contact, the breach sealed, the bodies burned), --canyon, --canyon-again, --squads, --opening, --sinkhole, --seats, --colony, --sectors, --laser, --skip-tutorial, --bestiary, --chapters, --pacing green; what was found red on the way: --pearl-story's motion audit (black 1-5 pops at cap 0.9 and at settle 4), its hull probe (the drifter's touch on its body), --laser-game (a duplicate groundAt binding in src/fx/laser-arsenal.js: the module did not load; then the footprint expectation)
